evidence.finding: Frontier section 5 assigns F2 only deterministic whole-portfolio snapshot composition, relationship analysis, scenario orchestration, comparative reports, and a cockpit projection over immutable canonical owner outputs. It grants no forecast, sizing, risk-policy, execution, reconciliation, or canonical-truth authority.

Capital already owns account and budget projection, allocation capacity, position truth, exact economics, supervision, and decision-chain topology. F2 must consume those snapshots and must not create a second allocator, position store, economics calculator, supervision policy, or topology owner.

The accepted Capital receipt explicitly records no production cross-lane scenario runner. The Capital scenarios namespace exports compatibility adapters and bindings, not a portfolio scenario engine or comparative scenario report.

Foundation already owns deterministic single-symbol synthetic fact generation, plan-level risk, execution state and data-only recovery recommendations, replay, and exchange-versus-local reconciliation. F2 must reference these owners and must not duplicate their scenario facts, risk verdicts, reducers, or reconciliation mechanics.

The frozen accepted Q lane owns historical atlas and replay, feature and model evidence, earlier-only analogs, calibration and abstention, bootstrap and per-sample cost stress, and experiment/model registries. Q cost stress varies costs and latency for strategy samples; it does not join or stress a whole portfolio. F2 must consume Q artifacts and must not recreate those primitives.

The frozen accepted L donor owns deterministic exchange-twin and single-subject exposure-recovery scenario mechanics. Its inputs are one product/symbol or one subject/strategy/proposal/symbol, not a whole-portfolio campaign. F2 must delegate fill, fee, liability, partial-leg, reconciliation, and recovery behavior to L/Foundation rather than model it independently.

No accepted owner composes one immutable snapshot across positions, proposals, liabilities, collateral, venue exposure, and strategy clusters. No accepted implementation derives portfolio concentration, shared factors, cross-asset correlations, or an asset-sector-venue-collateral-strategy financial relationship graph. Existing Capital topology is a decision-chain graph and Intelligence universe topology is a market-node/alias graph.

No accepted production owner runs cross-portfolio sweeps over canonical liquidity, capacity, funding, borrow, fee, slippage, and latency outputs; evaluates correlation-to-one, correlation breaks or sign flips, depeg, collateral haircut, crowding, shared-collateral contagion, trapped-position and recovery burden; or emits a comparative scenario matrix and drilldown carrying origin, seed, horizon, assumptions, missing dependencies, uncertainty, comparative-versus-absolute labels, no-sizing explanation, and ABSTAIN_UNKNOWN behavior.

F2 depends on exactly ADVISORY_ASSESSOR, SCENARIO_REFERENCE, and COCKPIT_PROJECTION. The first is advisory/shadow evaluation only; the second is immutable describe/list/schema validation only; the third is an honest panel/read-model projection only. F2 may not privately redefine any Dock envelope or acquire sizing, execution, mounting, controls, health, or page authority.

Q is frozen at 02b4eccc8d2ef53b830cafae06e5175715fa6ebb and L is frozen donor-ready at df6b472993ca9659ce09cf5f72004981c6835f0d. The active Role-4/I00 repair owns integration and mounting, not F2 portfolio-scenario semantics; its inspected change from rejected candidate 098f7b9 to b1a8af0 did not touch quant, liveEdge, capitalFoundation, or foundation. It is therefore a later port/release dependency, not a moving canonical owner that prevents this real-delta adjudication.
